profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
At my current position supporting NDEX project for FBI CJIS division, my focus is on crafting state-of-the-art serverless architectures that drive efficiency and innovation. With expertise in event-driven pipelines, cloud migration, and CI/CD enhancement, I've contributed significantly to the team's success. Our collaborative efforts have streamlined processes with automated testing and deployment frameworks.

My technical proficiency in a broad array of programming languages and cloud services is matched by a dedication to delivering robust security features in software development. With a strong command of node.js, Java, and various AWS services, I enable the project to achieve its strategic goals, ensuring our solutions meet the highest standards of functionality and data protection.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
·   Design, develop, integrate, and support Java 17/21 Spring Boot microservices for DCSA NBIS personnel-vetting and security-clearance workflows.
·   Translate application requirements into maintainable services and interfaces while coordinating dependencies across development, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and operational teams.
·   Build and maintain GitLab and Jenkins CI/CD workflows supporting source control, automated testing, controlled releases, deployment validation, and technical documentation.
·   Perform production support, root-cause analysis, defect remediation, and performance optimization for mission-critical applications and data-processing workflows.
·   Deploy and operate services on AWS EC2, Kubernetes, and OpenShift using Docker, Helm, health checks, monitoring, autoscaling, and CyberArk-managed secrets.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
·   Designed and implemented services for an event-driven, serverless data-ingest pipeline supporting an FBI Criminal Justice Information Services application. 
·   Integrated C#, Python, JavaScript, Node.js, Java 11, AWS Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, and CloudFormation to move and process data across distributed services.
·   Supported cloud-migration architecture, automated test frameworks, and Bamboo YAML CI/CD enhancements across AWS GovCloud, Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes, and Ansible.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
·   Designed, developed, tested, and deployed data-processing software for the FAA Airport Surface Anomaly Investigation Capability using C++, Python, and Jupyter notebooks.
·   Built and maintained containerized Linux services with Git, Docker, and Kubernetes and developed integrated web capabilities with ASP.NET MVC, C#, JavaScript, Node.js, HTML5, CSS3, and jQuery.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
·   Developed and integrated software capabilities for defense research programs supporting the Undersea Warfare Decision Support System, submarine-launched MK-28, and Orca Extra Large Unmanned Undersea Vehicle.
·   Built Java, Java Swing, JavaFX, OSGi, SOAP, and JAX-WS components using Maven and Ant and developed interactive mapping capabilities in C and C++.
·   Collaborated with system-integration teams in secure, air-gapped Linux environments using VLANs, firewalls, switching concepts, and controlled network access.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
·   Managed the full SDLC for secure distributed applications using Agile, test-driven development, pair programming, Docker, and Kubernetes.
·   Provided technical guidance through code reviews and design-pattern implementation and integrated OAuth 2.0 authentication into a retail web application.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Working agile methodologies with other developers to develop clean and maintainable code following best practices (unit testing, source control, continuous integration, automation, design patterns).
•	Using Spring Boot framework and Java to implement and modify Micro-services and Rest-API.
•	Developing web application by using HTML5, Angular JS, Angular 4, j-Query, and JavaScript framework. 
•	Understanding of Object Oriented Programming Design, Algorithms, and Data Structures.
•	Automatic testing by using Java, Cucumber, Selenium, TestNG.
•	Decomposing the business and technical requirements into test case scenarios, defining test data requirements, managing test case creation, and devising contingencies plans.
•	Quality Assurance Experience with system testing, planning and defect resolution by using Application Lifecycle Management and JIRA.

positions.title: Mathematics Tutor
positions.description:
• Assisting and guiding students step by step to solve the problems.
• Listening and pointing out the cause of the issue from the material and resolve the problem with students.
• Facilitating review workshops for Differential Equations course.

organizations.name: Mathematics Club
organizations.description:
• Founded club to provide forum for sharing mathematics knowledge.
• Conduct meetings and developed events to foster participation in activities.
• Work with faculty advisor and other officers to coordinate social events and math game activities.
• Organized Student Activities at the 7th annual Northwest Undergraduate Mathematics Symposium Spring 2015 Conference
